android.desc:
StarFlicks is a completely free, ad-free Movie & TV Show Tracker created with passion by an independent developer.

Tired of limits on your lists, annoying ads, and hidden subscription fees for extra features? StarFlicks is the clean, complete alternative built for true movie and series lovers.

Explore a massive catalog of Movies, TV Shows, Anime, and Cartoons. Track what you want to watch (Watchlist) and what you’ve completed (Watched), rate titles, and auto-generate personalized Rankings.

Key Features of StarFlicks:

🌍 EXPANSIVE CATALOG: Explore a massive, constantly growing library of titles and find out where to stream them.

📅 PERSONAL CALENDAR & ICS FEED: View upcoming release dates for titles in your Watchlist in monthly or weekly views, and sync your calendar to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar using an ICS Feed.

🔔 CUSTOMIZABLE PUSH NOTIFICATIONS: Never miss a release! Receive push notifications for Movies, TV Series, Seasons, and Episodes you follow, choosing your time zone, lead days, and notification time.

🔄 IMPORT FROM TV TIME & TRAKT: Easily migrate your entire watch history and data from TV Time or Trakt by simply importing your ZIP file in Settings.

📝 UNLIMITED & GRANULAR TRACKING: Manage your Watchlist with zero limits. Mark movies and TV series as watched down to individual seasons and episodes, with automatic bulk-marking for previous episodes.

🪐 PERSONAL RANKINGS (SAGAS & UNIVERSES): Auto-generate your personal "Top 50" aggregated by Sagas and Universes (Marvel, DC, Star Wars, etc.), showing at a glance what you've seen and what's missing.

🏆 AWARDS & IN-DEPTH DETAILS: Discover plots, official trailers, full actor filmographies, and major awards won by each title (Oscars & Emmys).

📊 DASHBOARD & STATS: View detailed charts of your rating distribution, discover your favorite genres, and explore total episodes and seasons watched.

🎨 ANIMATION FILTER: Easily separate Anime and Animated series from live-action content with a simple toggle.

🔀 ADVANCED FILTERS & SORTING: Filter by Genre (Action, Adventure, etc.), Universe (Marvel, DC, etc.), and Year. Advanced sorting for your lists (by Rating, Progress, Release Date, etc.).

🛡️ REAL RATINGS: You can only rate a title after watching it (for TV Shows, after completing at least Season 1), preventing fake ratings.

StarFlicks is an independent, non-profit project. Download it today and start tracking without limits!

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I'm a developer from Italy and I wanted to share a project I've been working on over the last year.

As a huge movie fan, I used apps like CineTrak for years, until they started imposing limits on lists. I also tried other popular trackers (TV Time, Letterboxd, IMDb), but for one reason or another, I couldn't find the perfect app for my needs. So, I built my own personal alternative and decided to make it public and completely free.

It's called StarFlicks. It has no ads, allows unlimited lists (Watchlist and Watched), advanced stats and filters, rankings based on global community votes and personal rankings created automatically based on your own ratings, along with upcoming releases and multi-language support (English and Italian).

On the technical side, I built it using Django (DRF) for the backend, Next.js for the web, and Expo for the Android app, all containerized with Docker. Currently, it's available on Web and Android. Unfortunately, it's not on iOS yet since this is a completely free, non-profit project. For now, I've decided not to invest in the Apple developer account, but I will be releasing a fully optimized PWA soon for iPhone users!

I'd love to hear your thoughts and get some genuine feedback to keep improving it, thanks for your support!

Web link: https://starflicks.it/
Play Store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.starflicks.app
quotes.story_title: Show HN: StarFlicks – A free movie tracker built with Django, Next.js and Expo
